detail.title: Investigating empirical frameworks for visual expectation violations
detail.summary: Building on the provisional synthesis of compositional constraints and linguistic incongruity in art, this cycle focuses on shifting from theoretical mapping to identifying empirical research. We are specifically looking for studies that quantify cognitive responses to violated visual expectations, moving beyond bibliographic categorization into measurable psychological or neurological data.
